attributes.action: Call for a new Prime Minister for the United Kindom.
attributes.additional_details: Instead of baning social media we call for proportionate rules focused on safety, age-appropriate content, and digital literacy — so young people can still connect, learn, create, and access support
attributes.background:
We call for a new UK Prime Minister to bring fresh leadership, improve economic stability, strengthen public services, and restore public trust.

We demand no total or blanket ban on social media for under-16s.

rejection.details:
You may be interested in signing this petition:
Do not ban social media for under 16s
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/757233
